annotations.title: Preview a copy of a saved search

description:
Quote a preview of a new alert copied from an existing one, archived or not. Poacher covers it, so nothing is charged. Copies the sources, brief, filters and schedules, with any changes, like “Create a new alert with these settings” in the app. The original is not changed. Dates that have passed must be changed first. Approve with approve_preview, then create the alert with create_alert_from_preview.

Permission: work:execute + alerts:read.

changes.description: Optional changes to the copied settings: name, criteria, review_results, exact_filters, sources (change copied ones by ID), add_sources (new search URLs) and remove_sources (copied IDs to drop).

add_sources.description: New sources to add. The alert keeps at most ten.

interval_seconds.description: How often to check, in seconds.

offsetMinutes.description: Minutes after midnight in timeZone at which checks are phased.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.

exact_filters.description: Filter patch; null removes that filter.

remove_sources.description: Saved source IDs to drop. At least one source must remain.

offsetMinutes.description: Minutes after midnight in timeZone at which checks are phased.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, for example America/New_York.

configuration_revision.description: Optional configuration_revision from get_alert_configuration; the copy fails if the alert changed since.

idempotency_key.description: A new random key (16–100 letters, digits, - or _) for each request. Reuse it only to retry the identical request.

maximum_charge_micros.description: Optional and ignored while Poacher covers previews. If you send it, use a whole number of at least 2 micros.

name: quote_copy_preview

answered_rounds.description: How many times this preview’s clarification questions have been answered.

check_again_after_seconds.description: While queued or running: call get_preview again after about this long while the person waits. Do not schedule a reminder for later instead.

covered_by_poacher.description: True when Poacher covers this preview: nothing is charged. Set when the preview is quoted and kept for its life.

minimum_charge_micros.description: The smallest maximum_charge_micros this preview accepts: enough for every setup step to reserve its most expensive case. You are charged actual cost, usually far less. 0 while Poacher covers the preview.

progress.description: What the preview is doing now, while it is queued or running.

maximum_charge_micros.description: The ceiling for the whole preview, across answered rounds. 0 for a covered preview.

status.description: covered: Poacher pays for this preview, so charged_micros is always 0. One of: "not_started", "pending", "final", "covered".

availability.description: What the source itself says about the listing: sold or out-of-stock results still appear in samples but a running alert never sends them. One of: "available", "unavailable", "unknown".

review_url.description: Account-authenticated relative path for human review; opening it does not activate monitoring.

daily_limit_micros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

remaining_micros.description: USD micros as an exact integer; 1,000,000 = $1. Spending ceilings are bounded to the safe integer range.

typical_minutes.description: How long previews like this usually take, in minutes, measured in production. Null once it has finished or stopped.

title: Preview a copy of a saved search
